description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Notice calling for claims to land parcels - Kebithigollewa D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 110388 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land ownership claims across multiple districts (Anuradhapura and Kilinochchi), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
